requirements_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary workloads: conversational support (chat), document search/embedding pipelines, and periodic reranking. Current hosted trial shows avg QPS 8 with 22 QPS peaks; token mix ~65% chat (avg 480 tokens), 25% embeddings (avg 900 tokens/doc), 10% rerank (avg 1.2k tokens). Target Dedicated sizing: sustain 40 QPS baseline with ability to handle short bursts to 120 QPS; target concurrency ~60 across pool. Latency SLOs: p95 chat <250ms for short responses, p95 long-output <600ms. Requirements: VPC deployment, SOC2 + SAML SSO, KMS-backed keys, audit logging, US data residency. Want autoscaling/burst policy and model fallback rules. Cost sensitivity moderate — seeking reserved pricing that reduces per-token by 25-40% vs hosted trial.
poc_success_criteria: Sustain 40 QPS with p95 latency <350ms on 95% of requests during synthetic traffic runs
Support burst to 120 QPS for 5 minutes without failed requests (graceful autoscale/fallback).
Validate VPC peering + egress rules with customer's infra team and pass security checklist.
Demonstrate at least 20% cost reduction per 1M tokens vs hosted usage through batching/caching/quantization guidance.
notes: Shorthand from calls: 'need predictability — spikes kill our SLA', CTO wants reserved pricing. Team mix: product (2 PMs), infra (1 lead), eng (6 ML/infra).
